subject.title: member-info fails with "fetch failed" on WSL2 in 2026.6.1 (SSRF fetch guard / undici dispatcher regression)

question: After live WSL2 Teams Graph reproduction, what guarded-fetch boundary is acceptable for Microsoft Graph requests that fail through the pinned Undici dispatcher while native fetch and curl succeed?
rationale: The likely repair crosses SSRF DNS pinning and dispatcher policy, so automation should not choose between preserving strict pinning, using a trusted proxy path, or relaxing pinning for this Graph call without maintainer security intent.

options.title: Require live repro before boundary changes
options.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer captures redacted WSL2 Teams Graph proof, then decide the narrowest fix that keeps the SSRF guard intact.

options.title: Route through the egress refactor
options.body: Let the broad HTTP egress refactor own this class only if maintainers accept its security model and it provides positive Teams Graph proof.

options.title: Close only after current proof succeeds
options.body: Close this issue only if a current-main or released build is live-proven to make `member-info` succeed on the reported WSL2/Graph path.

recommendation.title: Require live repro before boundary changes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer captures redacted WSL2 Teams Graph proof, then decide the narrowest fix that keeps the SSRF guard intact.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is primarily about the shared guarded transport and SSRF dispatcher boundary rather than the Teams action shape.
